summary: The new pagination guard introduces an off-by-one error and a hard limit that may break callers expecting full pagination.

findings.title: Off-by-one in pagination limit causes premature error
findings.body:
The loop `for (let i = 1; i < MAX_PAGES; i++)` runs at most `MAX_PAGES - 1` iterations. If the data set has exactly `MAX_PAGES` pages, the loop will exit with a non-null cursor and throw `pagination exceeded ${MAX_PAGES} pages`, even though the limit was not truly exceeded. This will cause callers to receive an error instead of the complete result set.

**Fix:** Change the loop condition to `i <= MAX_PAGES` (or `i < MAX_PAGES + 1`) so that up to `MAX_PAGES` pages are fetched before throwing. Also verify that `MAX_PAGES` is set to a value that callers can tolerate, and ensure all callers handle the new error case.
